subject.title: feat: ask_user follow-ups — harness convergence, channel finalization + reactions, native cards, docked web panel

question: Should existing paired-device tokens be upgraded to include `operator.questions`, or should the product require an explicit user reauthorization/re-pair flow before those devices may read and resolve gateway questions?
rationale: This is both an upgrade-compatibility decision and a permission-boundary decision: silently retaining stored scopes breaks the feature, while silently broadening a persisted operator token may exceed the prior grant.

options.title: Add explicit upgrade and recovery flow
options.body: Keep existing stored permissions intact, surface a visible reauthorization or re-pair recovery path, and prove it restores question access on Android and Apple clients.

options.title: Migrate existing eligible pairings
options.body: Broaden previously issued paired-device scopes only if maintainers confirm that the original operator grant already authorizes question read/resolve capability, with focused migration coverage.

options.title: Defer native question access
options.body: Land only the surfaces that do not require new paired-device scope and track native question cards separately until the permission contract is approved.

recommendation.title: Add explicit upgrade and recovery flow
recommendation.body: Keep existing stored permissions intact, surface a visible reauthorization or re-pair recovery path, and prove it restores question access on Android and Apple clients.

likelyOwner.reason: The current branch and the merged base question feature history place this product and implementation boundary closest to steipete.
